title: aglaia pinnata
intro: Aglaia pinnata, commonly known as the Bael tree or Indian bael, is a tropical plant native to Southeast Asia, belonging to the family Meliaceae. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, diarrhea, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Aglaia pinnata include flavonoids, alkaloids, and coumarins, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties. The plant's therapeutic actions also include its ability to reduce fever, alleviate pain, and exhibit immunomodulatory effects.
